acceptanceCriteria: Direct tests cover spanLines first/last-line boundaries, zero-count hunks and a '\\ No newline at end of file' hunk in spanUneditedByHunks, and assert exit 2 with code cite-span-not-stable.
One mutation per new case shows it bites.
body: Coverage gaps recorded by the single Codex round on PR #934 (V1-1418/1349, head bc22ba552) and in docs/build-log/2026-10-15-v1-1418-1349-cite-span-alignment.md: no direct spanLines boundary test; no zero-count hunk (@@ -N,0 / +N,0) or missing-final-newline hunk case for spanUneditedByHunks; no explicit exit-status assertion on the cite-span-not-stable refusal (exit 2).
title: cem cite span-alignment tests lack spanLines boundary, zero-count/no-newline hunk and exit-status cases
